newsitem.title: USA: Invacare has 25 pct of Healthdyne shares.
newsitem.headline: Invacare has 25 pct of Healthdyne shares.

text.p: Invacare Corp said Tuesday that as of April 28, about 2,580,313 shares of Healthdyne Technologies Inc common stock had been validly tendered, which, together with the 600,000 shares owned by Invacare, constitutes 25 percent of outstanding Healthdyne common stock.
Invacare also said it extended its $13.50 per share tender offer to purchase all the outstanding shares of common stock of Healthdyne until 1800 EDT/2200 GMT May 27.
Invacare said the offer may be further extended.
The offer had been scheduled to expire on Monday, April 28, Invacare said.
